# Comedian Website - Copilot Instructions

## Project Overview
A Next.js comedian portfolio website with public-facing pages and a password-protected admin dashboard.

## Tech Stack
- **Framework**: Next.js 14+ (App Router, TypeScript)
- **Styling**: Tailwind CSS
- **Auth**: NextAuth.js (admin login)
- **Storage**: Local JSON files (easily swappable for a DB)
- **Media**: next/image, next/video

## Project Checklist
- [x] Clarify Project Requirements
- [x] Scaffold the Project
- [x] Customize the Project
- [ ] Install Required Extensions
- [ ] Compile the Project
- [ ] Create and Run Task
- [ ] Launch the Project
- [ ] Ensure Documentation is Complete

## Features
- Public pages: Home, Photos, Videos, Tour Dates, Contact
- Admin dashboard: Upload photos, edit bio/text, manage videos, manage tour dates
- Password-protected admin via NextAuth.js credentials provider
- Template-friendly: all content stored in editable data files
